title: Transmitters for use in industrial process control systems, Part 2: Guidance fr installation, inspection and routine testing
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13122 (PART 2)) covers Transmitters for use in industrial process control systems, Part 2: Guidance fr installation, inspection and routine testing. This Indian Standard ( Part 1 ) was adopted by the by the Industrial Process Measurement and Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. The methods of evaluation specified in this standard are intended for use by manufacturers to determine the performance of their products and by users or independent testing esiablishments to verify manufacturers' performance specifications. This standard ( Part 1 ) is intended to specify uniform methods of test for the evaluation of the perfprmance of transmitters with pneumatic or electric output signals. Part 2 of this standard provides guidance for installation, inspection and routine testing of these transmitters. The test conditions in this standard, for example, the range of ambient temperatures and power supply, represent those which commonly arise in use.
